title: Dead Workers Still Vote — Cloudflare Connection Hygiene

intelligence.essence: A Cloudflare Worker wired to a GitHub repo keeps building on every push until its wire is cut — an unused account is not a disconnected account. Only current, relevant workers stay connected.

human_view.meaning: Shawn thought unused old workers were harmless. They posted 17 failing checks on every push, burying real signal. He deleted all 17; the next push came back clean.

intelligence.simple_view: Old lamps still buzz when you flip the switch. Unplug what you don't use.
intelligence.naya_view: Unused != disconnected. Audit connected workers like open gates; cut the wire immediately for anything not current.
intelligence.ai_view: Integration currency is a first-class hygiene dimension: enumerate connected integrations, verify each is current and relevant, remove the rest.

machine_view.rule: Only current, relevant Cloudflare workers remain connected to the repository.

decisions: Remove any Cloudflare worker not current and relevant, immediately
intelligence.uncertainty: None material; mechanism proven by removal test 17->0.
intelligence.applicability: Any GitHub-connected build integration (Cloudflare Workers/Pages, and by extension similar per-project webhooks).
intelligence.learning_lesson: Not using an account does not disconnect its integrations.
intelligence.successor_effect: Future seats check integration currency before trusting a clean check surface.
